title: Rejection probability from symbol frequencies
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $n$. The rejection probability of the tester that samples two coordinates independently and uniformly and accepts exactly when their values agree is twice the product of the fraction of false entries and the fraction of true entries in $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
